DRAWER

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2226
Date 27. 1. 31.

January 27, 31.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your
letter No.235/FOR/77(C.3), dated December 19,
1931, on the subject of one C.P. Godhard, and
to state that the firm in question has been
communicated with and informed that no action
can be taken by the Metropolitan Police.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

Commissioner of Police.

The Commissioner of Police
of the Metropolis,
New Scotland Yard,
London, S.W.1.

Central Station,
REPORT
Date January 25, 19 32.
Subject (in full) Attached file No. C. 5566.
Made by C. D. I. Mason. Forwarded by Jos. G. Adam.
Sir,
I beg to report that in connection with the above mentioned
file I interviewed the manager of Messrs. Schmidt and Company:
During the interview this gentleman stated that he had no other
information regarding Godhard other than that contained in his letter
addressed to the Metropolitan Police. He was informed that in the
absence of any further information no action was possible by either
Police Force.
（批：Crime Information Jff 26/1/32.）
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
Mason.
C. D. I.

SCHMIDT & CO.
Shanghai
Nanking Road, Sassoon Bldg.,
November 28th 1931

Officer in Charge
Police Force
Scotland Yard
London
(England)

Sir:-
Re: C. P. Godhard, British subject
This man was engaged with the Shanghai Municipal
Council, Educational Department. His contract with
the council was prematurely terminated on reasons unknown
to us. He left the Council's service on July 16th 1931.
One day previous to this he bought in our shop
1 Leica Camera with accessories at ............ Mex$ 571.20
and paid cash down an amount of ............ " 100. -
leaving a balance of .................... Mex$ 471.20
(which is at the present rate of exchange approximately
£ stlg. 29.16/2)
He obtained the goods under false pretences, having
produced his Council's Employment Contract as a guarantee,
being fully aware, that his services were shortly to be
terminated.
It transpires that G. has cheated several other
parties here, which have approached the Shanghai Municipal
Council, where these claims must be kept in files. We do
not wish to take civil actions against G., since the matter
is a purely criminal case.
To the Shanghai Municipal Council and H.M.Consulate
General of Shanghai G. named as his address
c/o "The English Club" Rue Flamand, Nr. 11,
Bruges (Belgium)
.. is rumoured that letters forwarded to this address
were non-delivered and returned to their local senders.
Since it is likely that G. has returned to England, we
herewith respectfully ask that the necessary actions be
taken to get hold of the man.
Yours obediently
SCHMIDT & CO.
(Sgd) ?

1931年11月28日

负责人
警队
苏格兰场
伦敦
（英格兰）

先生：-
事由：C. P. Godhard，英国臣民
此人曾受雇于上海公共租界工部局教育处。其与工部局的合同因我方不知晓的原因被提前终止。他于 1931 年 7 月 16 日离开工部局任职。
在此前一天，他在本店购买
1 台徕卡相机及配件，价格 ............ 墨西哥银元 571.20
并支付现金定金 ............ " 100. -
余款为 .................... 墨西哥银元 471.20
（按当前汇率约合
英镑 29.16/2）
他以虚假手段获取货物，出示其工部局雇佣合同作为担保，而他完全清楚其服务即将被终止。
据悉，G. 还欺骗了本地的其他几方当事人，这些当事人已接洽上海公共租界工部局，相关索赔必须存档。我们不希望对 G. 提起民事诉讼，因为此事纯属刑事案件。
G. 向上海公共租界工部局及英国驻上海总领事馆提供的地址为
比利时布鲁日弗拉芒街 11 号
“英国俱乐部”转
.. 有传言称，寄往该地址的信件未被投递并被退回给当地发件人。
鉴于 G. 很可能已返回英国，我们特此恳请采取必要措施将该人抓获。

此致
敬礼

施密特公司
（签名）?

Sir,
Reference D: C. (C. B.) remarks re pistol in possession of C. P. Godhard.
The undersigned interviewed C. P. Godhard at 11.45 a.m. July 17, at his flat in the Pearce Apartments. The following information was obtained:-
C. P. Godhard, until a few days ago was in possession of a S. V. C. Rifle and revolver, same being issued to him by the S. V. C. Office, in the capacity of drill instructor of the cadets at the Public School for Boys.
These weapons have been returned to the S. V. C. armory, quite recently and I am given to understand that Godhard has no other firearms in his possession at present.

H J Schmidt

Sir,
At 7.40 a.m. July 15, 1931, a telephone message was received
from Mr. Hore, the A/Headmaster of the Public School for Boys, N.
Szechuen Road, requesting a foreign detective to call at his
office at 9 a.m.
The undersigned attended and was told by Mr. Hore, that the
conduct of one of the Foreign teachers, a Mr. C. P. Godhard, has
been disgraceful and indecent lately, and that he had received
complaints from parents of boys attending school, and that he
(Mr. Hore) was going to suspend this teacher, but being afraid
that this man might cause trouble, he (Mr. Hore) requests the
protection of an Police officer.
Mr. Hore, then called in this teacher (C. P. Godhard) and in
the presence of the undersigned, explained to Godhard the com-
plaints received and suspended him from further duties, also in-
structing him to leave the school grounds immediately and not to
have any further contact with the school boys, pending instruc-
tions from the Municipal Educational Board.
Mr. C. P. Godhard, took his accusation and suspension calmly
and left the school premises, without causing any trouble whatso-
ever.
Mr. Hore, the Acting Headmaster, at the request of the under-
signed, then submitted further information regarding this matter,
as follows:-
C. P. Godhard, British, (Australian), was engaged as a teacher
for the Public School for Boys on Feb. 1931, on a three years
agreement. Lately several members of foreign teaching staff, had
received information from their pupils re the conduct of C. P.

school boys to his rooms at the F. Y. M. C. A. and there he misbe-
haved himself by his indecent manners.

This matter was being investigated by the A/Headmaster, with
a view of obtaining more facts, when a few days ago the parents of
a Russian school boy named "Dobrenko" furnished further informa-
tion.

This boy, aged 14, was invited by Godhard to visit his rooms
at the F. Y. M. C. A. while there Godhard played a gramophone,
undressed the boy, took off his own clothing and both danced around
the room, while Godhard committed indecent acts during this per-
formance.

The management of the F. Y. M. C. A. heard something about
this and Godhard was subsequently expelled from the "Y".

Mr. Hore, then took immediate action as already stated and the
matter is at present in the hands of the Municipal Educational
Board.

C. P. Godhard, resides at present at the "Pearce Apartments"
Flat 41, Boone Road. It seems that Godhard at times has abnormal
lapses and as it is believed that he has a pistol in his posses-
sion, observation may prevent acts, which an unbalanced mind is
capable of doing.

Mr. Hore, has given me to understand, that the parents of the
boy (Dobrenko) do not wish any publicity re this unfortunate
occurrence, and has asked me to treat this matter strictly con-
fidential, pending the outcome of the investigation by the
Municipal Educational Board.

代理校长正在调查此事以获取更多事实，就在几天前，一名名叫“Dobrenko”的俄罗斯学生的家长提供了更多信息。

这名 14 岁的男孩被 Godhard 邀请参观他在青年会的房间，在那里 Godhard 播放留声机，剥去男孩的衣服，脱下自己的衣服，两人在房间里跳舞，在此期间 Godhard 实施了猥亵行为。

青年会管理层听闻此事，Godhard 随后被青年会开除。

如前所述，Hore 先生随即采取了行动，目前此事已由工部局教育委员会处理。

C. P. Godhard 目前居住在博恩路皮尔斯公寓 41 室。看来 Godhard 有时会出现异常的精神失常，且据信他持有一把手枪，监视或许能防止心智失衡者可能做出的举动。

Hore 先生向我表示，男孩（Dobrenko）的父母不希望这一不幸事件公开，并要求我在工部局教育委员会调查结果出来之前，对此事严格保密。
